settings.name: TeamHandoff
notes: The lifecycle of one thing one team leaves for another. The connector's record_handoff already holds pending, blocked, ready, in_progress, completed and withdrawn. Staged and Returned are new, and today each could only be written as blocked with a note.
A receiving team that can only take what it is given has no contract. Returned is what makes this a service interface: the receiver can answer that the acceptance was not met.

events.name: ReceivingTeam
events.feeder: a session of the team it is left for

states.name: Pending
states.description: Store state: pending. The handoff is recorded with its receiving team and its offer. The carrier may not have landed yet.
states.prompt: Name the receiving team, the offer this delivers, and the record that will carry it. Choose the episode for this work: do not copy it from the binding line. Land the carrier, run the offer's checks and record each result.

states.name: Staged
states.description: New state; today it could only be written as blocked. No episode holds this yet. The concept waits in _staging_for_new_episodes with T5, for its foundation and a person's choice of birth.
states.prompt: T5: feed the concept and build its foundations packet. Leave the birth of the episode to a person.

states.name: Blocked
states.description: Store state: blocked. It waits for a person's decision or for another handoff. The note names which.

states.name: Ready
states.description: Store state: ready. The carrier exists at its address and its checks are recorded. A session of the receiving team can claim it. A team with no agent lead has nobody who will.
states.prompt: Receiving seat: read the carrier at its address and run the offer's acceptance. Claim it if the acceptance holds. Send it back with what is missing if it does not.

states.name: InProgress
states.description: Store state: in_progress. A named session of the receiving team holds it.
states.prompt: Do the work this asks for. Complete it with a receipt: what was delivered and where.

states.name: Returned
states.description: New state; today it could only be written as blocked. The receiving team says what was left does not meet the acceptance, and says what is missing.
states.prompt: Leaving team: read what the receiver found missing. Revise the carrier and record it again, or withdraw it with the reason.

states.name: Completed
states.description: Store state: completed. Its receipt says what the receiving team made from it and where.

states.name: Withdrawn
states.description: Store state: withdrawn. Its note says why.
